_note: Size and bag limits for the original species were extracted from DPIRD's Recreational fishing guide 2026 and the 'New statewide finfish size and bag limits from 1 June 2026' sheet. Species marked limits_verified=false show DPIRD group-level limits only (e.g. 16 nearshore fish per day in total); their species-specific size/bag values are being added from the guide. Official rules always prevail.
